newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Bankers Trust NZ posts NZ$18.3 mln nine mth profit.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust NZ posts NZ$18.3 mln nine mth profit.

text.p: Bankers Trust New Zealand Ltd said on Thursday in a key information summary required by the Reserve Bank that it posted a net surplus of NZ$18.3 million for the nine months to September 30.
Total assets were NZ$3 billion, up 41.3 percent from the previous period.
Capital adequacy was 23.1 percent of tier one capital and 25.5 percent of total capital.
During 1996 the bank had three exposures to banks of over 200 percent of total equity including a peak exposure of 290-300 percent of equity.
Bankers Trust NZ is a unit of Bankers Trust New York Corp.
